meta.title: DecisionGuard AI — Decision risk intelligence
meta.description: Analyze, anticipate and monitor the risks of your strategic decisions with verified multi-agent AI.

hero.title: Know what could go wrong, before you decide.
hero.subtitle: DecisionGuard AI examines every decision from eight angles — financial, strategic, legal, cyber, human, operational, predictive — then verifies its own conclusions before presenting them.

verified.title: Verified conclusions
verified.body: An independent audit agent checks the consistency, calculations and sources of every analysis.

reproducible.title: Reproducible scores
reproducible.body: Risk scores are computed by a deterministic engine, never improvised by the AI.

transparent.title: Facts ≠ assumptions
transparent.body: Every finding is labelled: verified fact, assumption, estimate or AI-generated hypothesis.

footer.disclaimer: DecisionGuard AI analyses support decision-making. They do not replace professional legal or financial advice.

auth.panelBody: Every analysis separates verified facts, assumptions and estimates. Your data stays isolated from other companies' data.
panelPoints: Hosting and compliance designed for GDPR
Audit trail of every sensitive action
auth.passwordHint: At least 12 characters. A passphrase works best.
auth.networkError: Cannot reach the server. Check your connection.

register.title: Create your workspace
register.subtitle: Your account and your company's, in one step.
register.terms: By creating an account, you accept that analyses are decision support, not legal or financial advice.

forgot.title: Forgot password
forgot.subtitle: Enter your address: if an account exists, you will receive a reset link valid for 1 hour.
forgot.sent: If an account exists for this address, an e-mail has just been sent. Check your spam folder too.

reset.title: New password
reset.subtitle: Choose a new password. All your open sessions will be signed out.
reset.done: Your password has been changed. You can now sign in.
reset.missingToken: This link is incomplete. Request a new reset link.
